tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a page on the Knock marketing site. Only known internal paths are accepted. Use `search_pages` first to discover valid paths.

path.description: Internal path starting with '/', e.g. '/pricing' or '/features/workflows'.

tools.name: open_contact_sales
tools.description: Navigate to the Knock contact sales page so the user can talk to the sales team. This does not submit the form.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search the Knock marketing site for pages matching a free-text query. Returns matching pages with their path, title, and description. Use this to help a user find the right page before navigating.

query.description: Free-text search query. Matches title, description, path, and keywords (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to the Knock newsletter. The email is added to the 'newsletter-subscribers' audience. Ask the user for confirmation before calling this tool.
